title: Acknowledgments
content: Thank you to my extraordinary family, who keeps me alive, and who never seemed to doubt that I could do this, despite the considerable odds. Special thanks to my Wonder Woman mother, who helps me find the magic on the darkest of days. And thank you to my good friends for their excitement and support, and to my long-lived but dearly departed cat, who was on my lap for so much of the writing in my life. I’m also eternally grateful to Holiday House and my editor Mora Couch, for all the hard work that went into the shaping of this book, as well as her positivity and enthusiasm for the story. And finally, thank you to Sara Kipin, for the gorgeous illustrations.
